borrow(uint256,uint256,address).details: It reverts if the reserve associated with the given reserve identifier is not listed.Caller must be `onBehalfOf` or an authorized position manager for `onBehalfOf`.Caller receives the underlying asset borrowed.

params.amount: The amount of asset to borrow.
params.onBehalfOf: The owner of the position against which debt is generated.

getReserveDebt(uint256).details: It reverts if the reserve associated with the given reserve identifier is not listed.The total debt of the reserve is the sum of drawn debt and premium debt.

getReserveSuppliedShares(uint256).details: It reverts if the reserve associated with the given reserve identifier is not listed.

getReserveTotalDebt(uint256).details: It reverts if the reserve associated with the given reserve identifier is not listed.The total debt of the reserve is the sum of drawn debt and premium debt.

getSuppliedAmount(uint256).details: The reserve identifier must match the asset identifier in the Hub.

getSuppliedShares(uint256).details: Shares are denominated relative to the supply side.The reserve identifier must match the asset identifier in the Hub.

getUserDebt(uint256,address).details: It reverts if the reserve associated with the given reserve identifier is not listed.The total debt of the user is the sum of drawn debt and premium debt.

getUserPremiumDebtRay(uint256,address).details: It reverts if the reserve associated with the given reserve identifier is not listed.

returns._0: The amount of premium debt, expressed in asset units and scaled by RAY.

getUserSuppliedAssets(uint256,address).details: It reverts if the reserve associated with the given reserve identifier is not listed.

returns._0: The amount of assets supplied by the user.

getUserSuppliedShares(uint256,address).details: It reverts if the reserve associated with the given reserve identifier is not listed.

returns._0: The amount of shares supplied by the user.

getUserTotalDebt(uint256,address).details: It reverts if the reserve associated with the given reserve identifier is not listed.The total debt of the user is the sum of drawn debt and premium debt.

liquidationCall(uint256,uint256,address,.details: It reverts if the reserves associated with any of the given reserve identifiers are not listed.The Spoke pulls underlying repaid debt assets from caller (Liquidator), hence it needs prior approval.

params.collateralReserveId: The reserveId of the underlying asset used as collateral by the liquidated user.
params.debtReserveId: The reserveId of the underlying asset borrowed by the liquidated user, to be repaid by Liquidator.
params.debtToCover: The desired amount of debt to cover.
params.receiveShares: True to receive collateral in supplied shares, false to receive in underlying assets.
params.user: The address of the user to liquidate.

repay(uint256,uint256,address).details: It reverts if the reserve associated with the given reserve identifier is not listed.The Spoke pulls the underlying asset from the caller, so prior approval is required.Caller must be `onBehalfOf` or an authorized position manager for `onBehalfOf`.

params.amount: The amount of asset to repay.
params.onBehalfOf: The owner of the position whose debt is repaid.

supply(uint256,uint256,address).details: The Spoke pulls the underlying asset from the caller, so prior approval is required.The reserve identifier must match the asset identifier in the Hub.

params.amount: The amount of asset to supply.
The amount of tokens to transfer.
params.token: The address of the ERC20 token to transfer.

withdraw(uint256,uint256,address).details: Providing an amount greater than the maximum withdrawable value signals a full withdrawal.The reserve identifier must match the asset identifier in the Hub.

params.amount: The amount of asset to withdraw.
